isabella.use: Default narrator, free and unlimited. Emotions are shaped (pace, pitch, tremble, echo), not acted.

isabella-gemini.persona: A warm young Englishwoman from London, a storyteller for English learners. Keep a clear British accent in every line.
isabella-gemini.use: Isabella's role with real acting: lessons, stories, history. The owner's pick from the voice test.

man-uk.persona: A calm middle-aged man, a gentle storyteller.
man-uk.use: Second narrator, fathers, teachers, old men in stories (like the owner's Voice Studio British man).

man-us.persona: A friendly young man in his twenties with a clear male voice.
man-us.use: Young men, friends, travellers (like the owner's Voice Studio American man).

kid-girl.persona: An eight-year-old girl with a light, high, bright child's voice, curious and sweet.
kid-girl.use: Children's videos and girl characters (like the owner's Voice Studio child voice).

kid-boy.persona: A nine-year-old boy, voiced like a cartoon boy: high, young, playful child's voice, never an adult voice.

epic.persona: A legendary narrator with a deep, rich, slightly gravelly voice, like the voice of an ancient chronicle.
epic.use: Legends, epic quests, history films and battles.

gulf-narrator.accent: Gulf Arabic (Khaleeji) dialect, natural Omani and Emirati style.
gulf-narrator.persona: A warm Gulf Arab man telling a story to friends in a majlis.
gulf-narrator.use: Arabic lines in Gulf dialect: hooks, explanations, story intros.

gulf-elder.accent: Simple Gulf Arabic, an old storyteller.
gulf-elder.persona: A deep, wise, older Arab man telling legends and history.
gulf-elder.use: Arabic narration for history and legend videos.
